card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

mechanism: A turns photo captioning into a graded recall test of a shared holiday remark.
confusable: Unlike simply reminiscing, A must prompt and test B's memory rather than supply the whole story.
comparison: D83-b offers a sentence stem and multiple choices; D83-a tests an unmarked preference after a labeled cup is identified.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
